frequency_question: How often do such committees execute a policy rate hike within an 87-day window when baseline conditions suggest tightening?
membership_rule: Includes formal monetary policy committee rate-setting meetings by major emerging market central banks where the prevailing rate cycle has been flat or declining and inflation targets are tested; excludes emergency inter-meeting interventions.

cases.name: Banco Central do Brasil Rate Decision Q3 2024

provenance_note: claims 16 cases from only 4 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 16 representative decision cycles enumerated from peer emerging market central banks.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier market central banks with pegged exchange rates.
skeleton: Quarterly rate-setting cycles across comparable emerging market central banks over the past decade
multiplier: 4 decision windows per year across 4 peer central banks over 10 years = 160 opportunities; historical tightening phase instances in flat-to-rising environments form the hit count.
validity_reason: Central banking governance frameworks and inflation-targeting mandates remain stable across multi-year horizons.
